data.one_liner: Generate type‑safe copyWith extensions for annotated classes and record typedefs.
data.what_it_does: It creates copyWith methods and optional copyWithNull helpers via the build system, allowing immutable objects to be cloned with modified fields. It also supports record typedefs and various customization options.
use_when: You need immutable data classes with convenient copy methods
You prefer code generation over manual boilerplate
You want support for Dart records and null‑clearing
avoid_when: You already use a full‑featured codegen like freezed or built_value
You want runtime reflection instead of generated code
strengths: Supports Dart records and advanced options like immutable fields
weaknesses: Limited to annotated classes/records, not dynamic objects
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner and copy_with_extension_gen to dev_dependencies, annotate classes with @CopyWith, run `dart run build_runner build`

alternatives.name: freezed_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides copyWith, immutability, and many other features in a single package, widely used in Flutter projects
